//go:build browser

// The polling helper every drive in testdata/ shares, copied in beside
// each by rastrillo's internal/scaffoldcheck (addDrive), which names
// the app's test package in place of this clause's.
package drivetest

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/harness"
	"github.com/chromedp/chromedp"
)

// settle waits until expression is true in the page. An evaluation
// that lands while a document is swapped in fails, and the next one
// reads the new page.
func settle(t *testing.T, rig *harness.Rig, expression string) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		var done bool
		read := harness.Into(&done, chromedp.Evaluate[bool](expression))
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(rig.Context(), time.Second)
		err := chromedp.Do(ctx, read)
		cancel()
		if err == nil && done {
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Fatalf("never true within 10s: %s", expression)
}
